en: Now follows the list of one hundred and eight names of Śrī Svāmī Samartha.
Oṃ, salutation to the sky-clad one. Oṃ, salutation to the one whose garment is dispassion.
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose garment is knowledge.
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose garment is self-bliss. Oṃ, salutation to the one whose garment is exceedingly divine splendor.
Oṃ, salutation to the bestower of the power of poetry.
Oṃ, homage to the giver of the nectar-mantra.
Oṃ, homage to the one who has bestowed divine knowledge.
Oṃ, homage to the giver of the divine eye.
Oṃ, homage to the one who attracts the mind. 10 Oṃ, homage to the one whose mind is tranquil.
Oṃ, homage to the one who bestows divine insight.
Oṃ, homage to the one who increases virtuous qualities!
Oṃ, homage to the giver of the eight supernatural powers! Oṃ, homage to the one who bestows devotion and detachment!
Oṃ, homage to the bestower of the power of enjoyment and liberation. Oṃ, homage to the impeller of the knowledge of the Self.
Oṃ, homage to the giver of the bliss of immortality.
Oṃ, homage to the burner of pride! Oṃ, homage to the one who has turned the six enemies green! 20.
Oṃ, homage to the protector of devotees!
Oṃ, salutations to the one who is the foremost of infinite millions of cosmic eggs.
Oṃ, salutations to the splendor of pure consciousness. Oṃ, salutations to the venerable Samarthayati.
Oṃ, homage to him whose arms reach his knees.
Oṃ, homage to the primordial teacher. Oṃ, homage to the venerable Śrīpāda, the beloved of Śrī.
Oṃ, salutation to Sarasvatī, the Sun of Nṛsiṃha.
Oṃ, salutation to Avadhūta Dattātreya.
Oṃ, salutation to Caṇḍaleśvara. 30.
Oṃ, homage to the dweller in the city of Kuruva. Oṃ, homage to the dweller in the city of Gandharva.
Oṃ, homage to the dweller on Mount Giranāra.
Oṃ, salutation to the one dwelling on Śrīśaila.
Oṃ, salutation to the one dwelling in Oṃkāra. Oṃ, salutation to the Sun of the Self.
Oṃ, homage to the one who sets forth sharp splendor.
Oṃ, homage to the bliss of unfailing splendor. Oṃ, homage to the bearer of intensely blazing splendor.
Oṃ, salutation to the Lord of the most perfected Yogīs. 40 Oṃ, salutation to the one most dear to Kṛṣṇa and Ānanda.
Oṃ, salutation to the Lord of the kings of the kings of Yogīs.
Oṃ, salutation to the embodiment of causeless compassion. Oṃ, salutation to the eternal consciousness.
Oṃ, salutation to the Lord whose root is self-bliss.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who goes to the rememberer. Oṃ, salutation to eternal consciousness and bliss.
Oṃ, salutation to the Lord who is the wish-fulfilling gem for devotees.
Oṃ, salutation to the inconceivable and stainless one. Oṃ, salutation to the treasure-house of compassion. 50.
Oṃ, salutation to the lord of the hearts of devotees.
Oṃ, homage to the armor for those who have come for refuge.
Oṃ, homage to the bestower of the manifestation of the Vedas. Oṃ, homage to the king of great mantras.
Oṃ, salutation to the bestower of the unstruck sound (anāhatanāda).
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose lotus-feet are most delicate. Oṃ, salutation to the self that is the power of consciousness (citśakti).
Oṃ, obeisance to the exceedingly steadfast one. Oṃ, obeisance to the one who delights in midday alms.
Oṃ, obeisance to the one marked by the alms of love. 60.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who brings security and prosperity. Oṃ, salutation to the wish-fulfilling tree for devotees. Oṃ, salutation to the architect of infinite power.
Oṃ, homage to the Supreme Brahman!
Oṃ, homage to the one who is supremely satisfied and utterly satiated!
Oṃ, homage to the giver of the thread of self-reliance!
Oṃ, salutation to the one who loves the state of childhood.
Oṃ, salutation to the treasury of devotion. Oṃ, salutation to the giver of capability to the incapable.
Oṃ, homage to the giver of the perfection of yoga. 70 Oṃ, homage to the one who loves the udumbara tree.
Oṃ, homage to the bearer of a body that is as exceedingly soft as a diamond.
Oṃ, homage to the bearer of the banner of the three forms.
Oṃ, homage to the one pervaded by the space of consciousness.
Oṃ, homage to the one who loves the fragrances of saffron, sandalwood, and musk.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who revives the practitioner.
Oṃ, salutation to the giver of the manifestation of Kuṇḍalinī. Oṃ, salutation to the protector of the unmanifest.
Oṃ, homage to the Increaser of Bliss. Oṃ, homage to the Treasure of Happiness. 80.
Oṃ, homage to Him who is Beyond Comparison.
Oṃ, homage to the one who is fond of devotion and song.
Oṃ, homage to the one who brings about grace that is established without cause. Oṃ, homage to the destroyer of the fear of worldly existence.
Oṃ, salutation to the bliss of smiling laughter. Oṃ, salutation to the one for whom all intentions are fulfilled. Oṃ, salutation to the giver of the fulfillment of all intentions.
Oṃ, homage to the giver of liberation from all bonds. Oṃ, homage to the sun of wisdom that transcends [ordinary] knowledge. Oṃ, homage to the mantras named Śrī and Kīrti. 90.
Oṃ, homage to the bestower of fearlessness and boons! Oṃ, homage to the stream of the nectar of the Guru’s play! Oṃ, homage to the one who holds the stream of the nectar of the Guru’s play!
Oṃ, homage to the one who holds the heart that is blissful and soft as a vajra.
Oṃ, homage to the two: the samādhi beyond conceptual construction and the non-conceptual samādhi. Oṃ, homage to the two: the samādhi beyond non-conceptuality and the innate (*sahaja*) samādhi.
Oṃ, homage to the one who has transcended the three times and knows the three times. Oṃ, homage to the one who has transcended existence and is absorbed in the meditative concentration on existence.
Oṃ, homage to the one who has transcended Brahmā and pervades even the subtlest atoms.

Oṃ, homage to the one who transcends the three qualities (*triguṇa*), yet possesses qualities, form, and auspicious marks. (100) Oṃ, homage to the one who binds with the rays of devotion that transcend all bondage. Oṃ, homage to the one who bestows the vision of the true body upon those who have transcended the physical body.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who is beyond thought and who excels all contemplation of love. Oṃ, salutation to the one who is dear to the state of *unmanī* which transcends silence.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who transcends the intellect and impels true awakening.
Oṃ, salutations to my beloved grandfather and true guru.
Oṃ, salutations to the lotus feet of the most holy Āsāheba.
Oṃ, salutations to the capable Lord of Akkalakoṭa.
